description: Lock a prediction (a creative comparison ranking, a video analysis, a study or a manual payload) with a SHA-256 hash and timestamp, so it can later be compared with what really happened. Pass source_id to seal a finished simulation, or payload for a manual prediction. Returns the id, hash and sealed payload.

source_id.description: Id of the comparison, video analysis or study run.

name: aetherya_seal_prediction
title: Seal a prediction before the outcome is known
